message: You know, there’s nothing quite like a good old-fashioned storm to remind us of how unprepared we can be. I once found myself knee-deep in snow with a pantry full of expired canned beans—let’s just say that wasn’t my finest hour! If you’re like me and appreciate the comedy of being caught off guard, it might be worth checking out some tips on winter weather preparedness. Just in case we find ourselves in another laughable situation! ❄️
